package main

import (
	"gno.land/r/gov/dao"
	valv3 "gno.land/r/sys/validators/v3"
)

func main(cur realm) {
	r := valv3.NewValidatorProposalRequest(
		cross(cur),
		[]valv3.ValoperChange{
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1lyt8fg7e987jgh7kxa3fn8zlcx295kdzuj7d8d"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1c5z9tqmcjendp46l8v6c2lu8xmrdyrk0tp5vn3"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1dhatg6m9svwh06fy5z4fqdeq6p6eduya3emm6a"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g19zqln3nnwcp4hqlvg7kv08p8ghe2cpk69qn0vs"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g16m0r7rm7fv5hx0ekr7gvx8g4fr7eu08nzhk6gt"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1fqcddarc4s9qap788t7lksgag4mq7g2gevc8ht"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1z8cw2urskllwj09wl62zz886ssnec3kkgu6qw5"), 5),
		},
		"Add 7 validator(s) to the valset",
		"Batch-add 7 operator(s) to the active valset with voting power 5.",
	)
	pid := dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), r)
	dao.MustVoteOnProposalSimple(cross(cur), int64(pid), "YES")
	dao.ExecuteProposal(cross(cur), pid)
}
